asOf: 17 November 2026, 7 pm IST, after the retention deadline
summary: Retentions are in, and none of the 20 top-rated players reached the auction. The best released players sit just outside: Hasaranga 11th of 64 bowlers, Nissanka 15th of 35 batters, Pathirana 19th. The Royals let Hetmyer and five seamers go and traded in Mohammed Shami, who is now their highest-rated bowler, just ahead of Archer.
confidence: Release and trade lists are as of 17 November 2026, 7 pm IST, from the ESPNcricinfo live blog [S14]. Purse and open-slot figures are as reported and can move with late trades.

needs.title: A bowler who delivers under pressure
needs.detail: Shami (28th of 64) and Archer (29th) are the Royals' best, both in the middle of the pack, and Bishnoi fell to 45th because his level dropped under pressure. The pool holds Hasaranga (11th), Pathirana (19th), Mustafizur (21st) and Ferguson (24th), each above both of them.
needs.evidence: Primary: outputs/rankings/bowlers_all.csv. Release lists [S14]. Reviews asked for one more death-overs option [S7].

needs.title: A middle-order batter, scarce in the pool
needs.detail: With Hetmyer gone, the rated middle order is Parag 24th, Shanaka 29th, Jurel 31st and Jadeja 35th of 35. No top-10 batter was released. The best released batter is Pathum Nissanka (15th), an opener, and the most tested middle-order option is Sikandar Raza (22nd).
needs.evidence: Primary: outputs/rankings/batters_all.csv. Release lists [S14]. Reviews called the middle order the biggest issue [S7].

needs.title: Test the openers before paying for certainty
needs.detail: Sooryavanshi and Jaiswal have the two best usual levels in the squad but almost no High-pressure balls, because openers are out or home before the crunch. The data cannot say how they finish chases; it is not a reason to buy, but it is a reason not to assume.

targets.name: Wanindu Hasaranga
targets.why: 11th of 64 bowlers, the highest-rated player in the auction pool and well above Bishnoi. 549 pressure balls, 75 in the High tier.
targets.risk: Missed IPL 2026 injured; takes an overseas place; his level dipped slightly under pressure (lift -1.2), which keeps him just outside the top 10.

targets.name: Matheesha Pathirana
targets.why: 19th of 64 bowlers with 111 High-tier balls, among the most tested seamers in the pool, and a death-overs role in the data.
targets.risk: Fitness and workload history; overseas place.

targets.name: Pathum Nissanka
targets.fit: Top-order anchor; would have to bat at three or four here
targets.why: 15th of 35 batters (+5.3), the best-rated batter released and above every Royal. 842 pressure balls, 52 in the High tier.
targets.risk: An opener by trade, so he overlaps with Sooryavanshi and Jaiswal; overseas place.

targets.name: Lockie Ferguson
targets.fit: Fast bowling, middle overs and death
targets.why: 24th of 64 bowlers; his level rose under pressure, the opposite of Muzarabani's. 50 High-tier balls.

targets.name: Sikandar Raza
targets.availability: In the pool: no IPL appearance since 2024 in the data
targets.why: 22nd of 35 batters and 25th of 64 bowlers, tested in both (55 and 29 High-tier balls). The closest the pool comes to the middle-order gap.

targets.name: Avesh Khan
targets.why: 44th of 64 bowlers but the most tested seamer in the pool (167 High-tier balls), and Indian, so all three overseas places stay free.
targets.risk: Rated below Shami and Archer, so depth rather than an upgrade.

targets.name: Mustafizur Rahman
targets.availability: Released: by KKR [S14]; whether he can play IPL 2027 is unclear [S13]
targets.risk: The BCCI directed his release in January 2026 amid political tension [S13]; do not plan around him until his eligibility is confirmed.

caveats: Release and trade lists are as of 17 November 2026, 7 pm IST [S14]. Late trades before the auction can still change who is available.
Ratings measure how players performed in this data, 2022 to 2026. They do not account for price, age, fitness, or how a player fits the Jaipur pitch.
Hasaranga, Pathirana and Ferguson are all overseas. The Royals have 3 overseas places, so buying all three uses every one; an Indian seamer such as Avesh Khan keeps one free.
Data Pack facts take precedence over media reports. The purse and open-slot figures are reported, not confirmed by the IPL.
